effect_interpretation: Fractional iron absorption was reported as approximately 40-50% higher with alternate-day compared with consecutive-day dosing under the studied conditions.
applicability_notes: Relative effect applies to the studied oral iron dosing regimen. It should not be treated as a universal 40-50% absorption increase for all oral iron users.

effect_interpretation: Beverages with 20-50 mg total polyphenols per serving reduced non-haem iron absorption by 50-70% versus water.
population_description: Healthy adults; radio-iron absorption from a low-inhibitor bread meal (Hurrell 1999)
applicability_notes: Dose band from beverages. Between 50 and 100 mg the engine interpolates to ABS_MOD_IRON_003. Applying to polyphenols in solid foods is an extrapolation. Adding milk did not change the effect.

effect_interpretation: Beverages with 100-400 mg total polyphenols per serving reduced non-haem iron absorption by 60-90% versus water.
population_description: Healthy adults; radio-iron absorption from a low-inhibitor bread meal (Hurrell 1999)
applicability_notes: Dose band from beverages. Above 400 mg, held at this band. Adding milk did not change the effect.

applicability_notes: Food-specific row; higher interaction_priority, so it replaces the dose-band rows for black tea in the same conflict group. Calibration evidence: do not use Hurrell 1999 meals as held-out validation.

applicability_notes: Dose-response point. Engine interpolates on log dose between phytate points (005, 006, 007); 0% effect at 0 mg. Food phytate in mg is converted to phytate P using 28.2% (ASSUME_002).

effect_interpretation: 25 mg phytate phosphorus reduced non-haem iron absorption by 64%.

effect_interpretation: 30 mg ascorbic acid overcame the inhibition from maize bran containing 10-58 mg phytate P.
applicability_notes: Engine removes phytate inhibition in proportion to ascorbic acid, scaled at 30 mg per 58 mg phytate P (ASSUME_005). Shown on the phytate waterfall bar, not as a separate vitamin C bar.

applicability_notes: Below 165 mg the engine scales linearly from 0% at 0 mg (ASSUME_006).

effect_interpretation: Inhibition was dose related up to 300 mg calcium; 300-600 mg reduced absorption by 50-60%.
population_description: Healthy adults (126 subjects); calcium as milk, cheese or calcium chloride (Hallberg 1991)
applicability_notes: Held at this range above 600 mg.
